Both predecessors and the new result set remain separate. The running Netcup service does not require the Mac to stay awake; local monitoring may pause when the Mac sleeps. The legacy live tracks below still refer to the ORIGINAL experiment, not either newer run. Custom development and a demonstrated custom win remain unfinished. See stage2/netcup/credit_only_preparation_20260922.md.
